question: Should Reef core own and support the Node/PostgreSQL relay, container image, Helm chart, schema migrations, and compatibility contract alongside the Cloudflare relay?
rationale: Mechanical review cannot decide whether the repository should assume the ongoing release, migration, availability, and parity obligations created by a second production platform.

options.title: Own both platforms
options.body: Accept the Kubernetes/PostgreSQL adapter as core-supported after real-cluster proof and an explicit compatibility and release boundary are documented.

options.title: Keep only the contract
options.body: Retain the shared relay contract and Cloudflare refactor while moving the Node/PostgreSQL runtime and Helm packaging to a separately owned integration.

options.title: Pause platform expansion
options.body: Hold or close the work until an operational owner and concrete image, migration, and support plan are established.

recommendation.title: Own both platforms
recommendation.body: Accept the Kubernetes/PostgreSQL adapter as core-supported after real-cluster proof and an explicit compatibility and release boundary are documented.

likelyOwner.reason: The Reef design records Peter's approval, providing the strongest available evidence for ownership of this product-direction choice.
